course_description: A comprehensive 8-week journey from AI fundamentals to building advanced multi-agent systems for IT operations.
target_audience: Network Administrators, IT Operations Engineers, System Administrators

phases.title: Phase 1: AI Literacy & Foundations
phases.summary: Master the terminology and core concepts of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning in the context of IT operations.

phases.title: Phase 2: Mastering Prompt Engineering
phases.summary: Learn the art and science of communicating with Large Language Models using industry-standard patterns and advanced prompting techniques.

phases.title: Phase 3: AI-Driven Automation & Systems
phases.summary: Integrate AI into your daily workflows using Python, Ansible, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

phases.title: Phase 4: Real-World Implementation
phases.summary: Apply everything you've learned to build a production-ready AI solution for a complex IT problem.

phases.title: Phase 5: Professional AI Fluency & Solutions
phases.summary: Master the skills employers want: build 20+ real-world solutions and boost your workplace productivity with Google-grade AI fluency.
